sources.title: Tree Preservation Orders and trees in conservation areas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: A TPO can protect specific trees, groups or woodland and generally prohibits cutting, topping, lopping, uprooting or wilful damage without written consent; conservation-area trees have separate notice controls.

sources.title: Tree felling in England
sources.verified_claim: The Forestry Commission's current collection distinguishes felling-licence requirements, exemptions, constraints and illegal felling. Felling-licence rules do not prove a sample tree is subject to a TPO or conservation-area control.

sources.title: Trees and woodland guidance for local authorities
sources.verified_claim: Current local-authority guidance covers planning, protection and management of trees and woodland, but general policy does not establish a candidate-specific protected tree.

sources.title: Appeals
sources.verified_claim: Planning guidance confirms statutory appeal routes for TPO consent decisions. Availability of an appeal route is process evidence, not evidence of a TPO or consent affecting a sample parcel.

sources.title: Tree protection and planning
sources.verified_claim: Enfield publishes TPO locations in CSV, GeoJSON and GPKG and explains statutory protection from TPOs, conservation areas and planning conditions. parcel_30762 is not marked protected without exact spatial matching.

sources.title: Tree Preservation Orders (TPOs) and trees in conservation areas
sources.verified_claim: Havering requires consent for work to protected trees and provides online mapping for TPO and conservation-area status. The mapping service must be queried at the exact candidate location.

sources.title: Tree Preservation Orders (TPOs)
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth maintains a TPO schedule and requires consent for works to protected trees. Borough-wide counts do not identify parcel_61522 or a particular tree.

sources.title: Trees in Conservation Areas
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth requires six weeks' prior notice for relevant works to trees in conservation areas, subject to exemptions. Exact conservation-area and tree location still require a property-level check.
